title: Inquest called into woman's death
article: An inquest into the death of a Smiths Falls woman who died in custody after a court appearance three years ago will begin March 7.

Diane Jeannine Lisle, 62, died Jan. 7, 2013, when she collapsed in the back of a police vehicle outside the Smiths Falls courthouse as she was about to begin the trip back to the Ottawa Carleton Regional Detention Centre.
Paramedics tried to resuscitate her, but she was pronounced dead at the scene.
At the time, Lisle was in the care of Ontario Provincial Police special constables.
